prompt.project_info: Photorealistic waterfront lifestyle portrait on a weathered wooden pier in natural diffused daylight.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with wet dark-brown hair slicked back, natural skin texture and a playful soft smirk, wearing a black twist-front bandeau bikini with thin halter straps and delicate ruffled trim on the bottoms.
prompt.composition_elements: Balanced medium shot of the approved adult reclining on a rustic damp wooden pier, looking slightly off-camera. Keep the black two-piece swimwear, relaxed seated/reclining pose and shallow depth of field with the water softly blurred.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural slightly diffused daylight highlights moisture on skin and hair; muted palette of deep green-grey rippling water, warm weathered wood and black swimwear.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic candid lifestyle photography, medium framing, natural skin and wet-hair texture, relatively shallow depth of field, realistic muted color treatment.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic medium-shot waterfront lifestyle portrait of one original approved adult woman with wet dark-brown hair slicked back, natural skin texture and a playful soft smirk looking slightly off-camera. She reclines on a rustic weathered damp wooden pier wearing a classic black two-piece bikini with a twist-front bandeau top, thin halter straps and delicate ruffled trim along the bottoms. Set the scene beside a vast body of water with dark green-grey ripples catching the light. Use natural slightly diffused daylight that highlights moisture on skin and hair, balanced composition, relatively shallow depth of field keeping the woman sharp and the water softly blurred, and a muted natural palette of deep water, warm wood and black swimwear.
